title: MTB resistotyper — ideal serving input (v1.0.0)
description: The canonical input we ask users to send for drug-resistance prediction. It is the CRyPTIC/gnomonicus genotype + sample QC covariates, in GARC nomenclature (design/16). It deliberately contains NO catalogue interpretation (no effects/predictions/R-S calls) — replacing that interpretation is exactly what the model does, and including it would leak the answer. Absence of a variant means wild-type/reference at that locus; the model treats any panel mutation not listed here as 0.

sample_id.description: Opaque sample identifier (CRyPTIC UNIQUEID, or any user id).

nomenclature.description: Mutation-string grammar. GARC (Grammar for Antimicrobial Resistance Catalogues) is the canon — the format piezo/gnomonicus and the CRyPTIC DB use. Other nomenclatures (HGVS, WHO-rav) must be translated to GARC upstream of this file.

source.description: Optional provenance of the variant calls (which caller/pipeline produced them).

covariates.description: Sample-level QC + lineage. All three required fields are model inputs (cov__lineage_*, cov__median_coverage, cov__tb_breadth); in the CRyPTIC DB these are 100% populated, so requiring them is safe.

lineage.description: Primary lineage, e.g. 'lineage2'. One-hot encoded to cov__lineage_L1..L4; a value outside 1-4 is allowed and maps to all-zero lineage one-hots.

breadth.description: Percent of reference covered (CRyPTIC TB_COVERAGE) -> cov__tb_breadth.

sublineage.description: Optional finer lineage, e.g. 'lineage2.2.3'. Not a current model input; carried for provenance/future use.

variants.description: All called variants across the CRyPTIC gene panel (not just resistance genes — phylogenetic/synonymous calls are expected and used by the de-novo model's summary features). Anything not listed is treated as reference. Duplicate (gene, mutation) pairs should be collapsed upstream.

gene.description: CRyPTIC/tbdb gene symbol, e.g. 'rpoB', 'katG', or a locus tag 'Rv0008c'.

mutation.description: GARC mutation string: amino-acid (S450L), stop (R305!, !489Y), nucleotide (a-15c, g-78c), indel (110_del_a, 1349_ins_1_c), synonymous (F320F). Joined with gene as raw__<gene>_<mutation> for the model.

frs.description: Fraction read support of the alt allele (CRyPTIC FRS). Frequently null even in the source DB; the de-novo model's mean_frs summary is computed over non-null values only.

coverage.description: Read depth at this variant (CRyPTIC COVERAGE).

is_minor.description: True if a minor/hetero-resistance allele call (CRyPTIC IS_MINOR). Feeds the n_minor summary. hAMRonization has no equivalent field.
